segments.name: Retail furniture
segments.description: Specialty retailer of residential furniture and accessories for middle to upper-middle income customers in Southern and Midwest U.S. markets.
segments.evidence: Havertys is a specialty retailer of residential furniture and accessories.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Havertys for furniture and accessories, including delivery fees charged to customers that are included in net sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Delivery fees of approximately $ 30,247,000 , $ 29,279,000 and $ 36,187,000 were charged to customers in 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively, and are included in net sales.
